vertebrae.cache.fingerprint
===========================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.cache.fingerprint

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Conservative cache fingerprint helpers.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.cache.fingerprint.hash_json
   vertebrae.cache.fingerprint.fingerprint_array_like

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: hash_json(value)

   Hash a value after conservative JSON normalization.

   :param value: Value to fingerprint.

   :returns: SHA-256 hash string.


.. py:function:: fingerprint_array_like(value)

   Fingerprint an array-like or sparse-matrix value.

   :param value: Value to fingerprint.

   :returns: SHA-256 hash string.


.. py:function:: fingerprint_extractor_recipe(recipe)

   Fingerprint a serializable extractor recipe.

   :param recipe: Extractor recipe dictionary.

   :returns: SHA-256 hash string.
